scope: hydraulic-model-independent verification of the Ross 2003/2011 first-order face-flux linearization and tridiagonal continuity update
interpretation_rules: Passing this gate proves only continuity algebra, conservation and bounded linear solve structure.
It does not qualify Ross face physics, SWAP hydraulic functions, saturated-unsaturated switching, timestep accuracy, groundwater coupling or production use.
No acceptance threshold may be relaxed after seeing the run result without a new explicitly versioned gate.
